claims: Amy Madigan was born on September 11, 1950.
Amy Madigan was born in Chicago, Illinois.
Amy Madigan is an American actress.
Amy Madigan won the 2026 Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress for her role as Aunt Gladys in Weapons.
Amy Madigan won Best Supporting Actress for Weapons 40 years after her first nomination.
Amy Madigan received an Oscar nomination for Twice in a Lifetime in 1985.
Amy Madigan had a role in Field of Dreams (1989).
Amy Madigan had a role in Uncle Buck (1989).
Amy Madigan had a role in Gone Baby Gone (2007).
Amy Madigan acted in Grey's Anatomy as Dr. Wyatt.
Amy Madigan has been married to actor Ed Harris since 1983.
Amy Madigan and Ed Harris have one daughter named Lily.
